theme_strategy: Hybrid App (Dark Theme for Marketing to emphasize 3D/metallic visuals; Light Theme for Admin Dashboard for data density and clarity)

font_family.heading: Clash Display, Cabinet Grotesk, or Manrope (Premium Industrial / Architectural)

rules: Never center-align large blocks of text; optical left-alignment creates structural tension.
Use tracking-tight for all headings above text-2xl.
Product SKUs and measurements must use monospaced fonts for tabular alignment.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders globally to represent precision engineering. No soft edges. Max rounded-sm (2px) or completely sharp corners (rounded-none).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Crystal Variant for marketing sticky navs. bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl, 1px inner top border border-white/20.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Marketing: No soft drop shadows. Use harsh inner shadows or sharp glowing borders. Admin: Subtle ambient shadows shadow-sm for cards only.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain on marketing backgrounds to give a tactile, raw industrial metal feel.

marketing.hero: Full screen (min-h-screen). Absolute positioned 3D elements/images. Text anchored to left.
marketing.bento_features: Asymmetric Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8). Mix span-4, span-8, span-12 for visual tension.
marketing.product_pdp: 3-column layout. Left (col-span-3): Hi-Res sticky image. Middle (col-span-6): Details/Specs. Right (col-span-3): Sticky Quote Builder card.

admin.structure: Fixed 240px left sidebar, 1fr main content area.
admin.density: High density for data tables. Row heights of 40px. Strict left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers.
admin.cards: Flat, 1px border, white background. Grid cols-4 for KPI summaries at the top.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use generous padding (p-12 to p-24) for marketing sections. Dense padding (p-4 to p-6) for admin views.

component_rules.html_vs_shadcn: Marketing sections must use custom HTML/Tailwind for artistic layouts. Do NOT use Shadcn Card for marketing bento layouts. Admin must heavily use Shadcn UI (Table, Form, Select, Dialog).
component_rules.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Hover state adds a 1px solid border or slightly translates X.
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn Form. Inputs should have bg-transparent and bottom border only (border-b) for a clean architectural look in marketing, and standard box inputs in admin.
component_rules.tables: Admin tables must be scalable, scannable, with fixed headers.

framer_motion.hero_reveal: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
framer_motion.scroll_parallax: Use useScroll and useTransform for subtle 2.5D image depth on product images.
framer_motion.hover_states: Product cards scale image by 1.05x, reveal action buttons via opacity transition.

rules: Avoid bouncing effects. Use strict, fast spring physics (stiffness: 300, damping: 30) for a mechanical feel.

Close-up of numerous stainless steel rods.

3d_libraries: framer-motion (for 2.5D scroll parallax if 3D models are unavailable)

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio. Text over images MUST have a linear gradient overlay (e.g. bg-gradient-to-r from-black/80 to-transparent).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: You are working with .js / .jsx files, NOT .tsx. All components must be valid JSX/JS, avoid TypeScript syntax.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use a generic SaaS blue for this brand. Stick strictly to Carbon, Silver, and the Orange accent.
CRITICAL: For the marketing site, DO NOT use rounded-lg or rounded-xl anywhere. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm for a sharp, machined, architectural aesthetic.
CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g. data-testid="submit-quote-btn").
CRITICAL: Admin dashboard tables must use dense mode (py-2 px-3 for cells) to match high-density 2026 SaaS trends.
CRITICAL: Implement two distinct contexts/layouts. A Dark Theme Marketing Layout, and a Light Theme SaaS Admin Layout.
CRITICAL: Use Lucide React for icons, but set strokeWidth to 1.5 to make them feel more premium and refined.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics (centered layouts, simplistic gradients).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glassmorphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and overlays.
NEVER use universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use pre-existing Shadcn components from src/components/ui when applicable.
